video_caption: Our chillies and Jams are the stuff of myths, designed to outlast empires, survive tsunamis, and power the post-apocalyptic feast.
hero_subheading: Grown and produced in New Zealand
story_text:
A little patch of resilience at the end of the earth. We're more than just chillies — from fiery peppers to healing roots, lush greens to exotic fruits, everything we grow is shaped by volcanic soil, salty ocean breezes, and weather tough enough to forge plants that thrive against the odds.

Our chillies have been grown with love, care and attention for over 10 years — and it shows in every jar. Loved by everyone who tries it, our jam starts with heirloom seed varieties, propagated by hand and nurtured using only organic sprays and organic fish fertiliser. No shortcuts — just good soil, good seed, and a lot of patience.
story_heading: Welcome to Hot Stuff Urban Farm
location_line: Organic. Heirloom. Grown for over 10 years.
